input_messages.content: Hi, I need some help with my recent order. I want to return or cancel everything that isn’t related to my new interest. Can you help me with that?
I’d like to keep only the things that are actually useful for my new hobby. Everything else, I want to return or cancel. Can you check my order and let me know what’s eligible?
I want to keep only the things that are actually for gaming. Please return or cancel everything else. Also, I’d prefer my refund through PayPal if possible.
Yes, that’s correct. Please go ahead and start the return for those items and make sure the refund goes to my PayPal. Let me know if you need anything else from me.
Wait, I really want the refund to go to my PayPal. This is really frustrating. Can you transfer me to a human agent who can help me with this?
